title: Desiccation and Relaxation Regimes in Fracture of Drying Clay Films
locators: PDF pp. 1–3 and 6; method, cracking sequence, limitations

conditions.material: Laponite RD and methanol suspension in a Petri dish
conditions.observations: Continuous mass loss and interval photographs of cracks

facts: Earlier rapid shrinkage produces large cracks; later narrow cracks are interpreted in terms of residual stress and particle rearrangement.
The experiment distinguishes different stages of crack development rather than one whole-body hardness threshold.
doesNotVerify: Methanol film is not water-based coiled pottery; no validated coefficients for weather pulses, stress decay or spontaneous healing.
